howto.name: Upload an M4A audio file
howto.text: Drop a .m4a file (iTunes purchases, GarageBand exports, iPhone voice memos).

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. FFmpeg re-encodes the AAC audio inside the M4A container as a 192 kbps MP3, compatible with every player on earth.

faq.a: M4A (AAC inside an MP4 container) isn't universally supported — older car stereos, some Android players, and many legacy devices won't play it. MP3 works everywhere.
Slightly. M4A's AAC codec is more efficient than MP3, so at the same bitrate AAC sounds better. Our 192 kbps default produces a result that's indistinguishable from the source for casual listening.

faq.q: Does it work for iPhone voice memos?
faq.a: Yes — voice memos export as M4A and convert cleanly to MP3 here.
